easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.
